sample_allocation_assumption: Recover the full recurrent pool across the observed cohort; counts are weights, not equipment capacity.
capacity_assumption: When known, 100 instrument-hours are independently stipulated for the same one-month pool. Use records are incomplete; unaccounted hours are not established idle hours.
cost_scope: Only the three named synthetic cost components; no personnel, consumables, tax, salvage, discounting, replacements, failure or clinical outcomes are inferred.
